description: This React component file defines a note detail page in a Next.js application, managing and displaying note data, including tags, content, and folder information, with functions for loading, saving, and deleting a note.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the note and list of notes to populate state variables for rendering.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current note state to the server by calling updateNote.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes the current note after user confirmation and redirects to the notes list.
